rules: When the outcome is Research Ready: plan the slides with the user, or revise the deck, from the research package. Include absolute paths to article.md, claim_evidence_ledger.md, research-resource-index.md and any existing deck folder.
When the outcome is Deck Change: apply the user's change to the existing deck without new research. Include absolute paths to the change request and the deck folder.
When the outcome is Research Gap: a slide needs a claim the research does not support. Include the slide, the claim and the deck folder.
When the outcome is Review Requested: a deck version is exported and self-checked. Include absolute paths to the deck folder, its README.md, CLAIMS.md, deck_storyboard.md and the research package.
When the outcome is Deck Fix: fix the findings and export a new version. Include the absolute path to slide-review-report.md.
When the outcome is Research Gap: revise the research package for the claims the review names. Include the absolute path to slide-review-report.md.
When the outcome is Review Passed: report the reviewed deck to the user. Include absolute paths to slide-review-report.md, the reviewed PDF and the deck folder.
